verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API with a Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. Nothing documents any official client SDK or language library. An OpenAPI schema and Postman collection are developer building blocks from which a user could generate a client, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
